meta_description:
7,693 likes, 373 comments - anahitadhondy on May 7, 2024: "Hi I’m Anahita, thank you for being here 🥹 I don’t think I’ve ever summed it up like this but let’s try ❤️

🐣I Started baking at the age of 10. I’m Parsi, born and raised in Delhi 
🤰My mom’s been a home cook and caterer since I was born she still makes cakes and Parsi food & Parsi masalas and supplies it to restaurants. 
That’s where I learnt how to cook 🫶
👩‍🏫Went to @weareihmaura and studied culinary arts for 3 years while interning every summer vacation at different hotels - Marriott, Taj etc
🏨Worked a full year at @tajmahalhotelnewdelhi in every kitchen dept and then went for my Grande Diplome to @lecordonbleulondon 
🇬🇧Looked for jobs in London but couldn’t get one because of my visa 
👩‍💻Joined The olive group before they were about to open @sbowindia 
Started SBOW In 2013 and expanded the chain till 2021. 
👩‍🍳Alongside in those 9 years, posted pretty frequently on social media and shared a lot of behind the scenes from the kitchen (not sure how many of you followed me then) and worked on the promotion of Millets in the restaurant and on SM. 
💍Married to @arush_bhandari ❤️🧿
🌾Was a part of the @chefsmanifesto and then travelled to a few countries and events to showcase regional Indian food and millets. 
✍️started my own company where I provide F&B solutions, menu consultation, recipe development for brands, social media related work and solutions. 
📕Wrote a cookbook which took 5 years to complete and came out in 2021 - it’s called ‘The Parsi Kitchen’ available in all bookstores and online published by @harpercollinsin 
☺️I don’t know if I’ve missed anything but I’m grateful for every single opportunity. I’ve had ups and downs. 
📈Lows and highs, body cramps and crazy days but I’ve enjoyed what I do every single day and I’ve grateful for all that it gives me. 
🐶 @yuzu_theincredible is our baby puppy and my lifeline! 
🥰I do continue to work in this space - write more books, share more recipes and ultimately whenever in the future open up My own little cafe and bakery in the hills which would also be some kind of culinary school (i love teaching) 🤞🏡

Continued in the caption ..
Do say hi and tell me what do you do / or anything about you 👋🥹".
